name: reactorpro-bridge
description: ReactorPro mesh bridge for RTerm — full-duplex ReactorPro mesh citizen (auto-started on boot): discover peers, dispatch signed tasks, register RTerm with the mesh registry, AND serve as a peer (answer inbound requests on mesh.agent.{id}.inbox, auto-started), publish signed heartbeats, answer discovery broadcasts. Speaks the ReactorPro wire convention (sig/pub/fp Ed25519, v0.3.0 envelopes) over a shared NATS server — the same convention the ReactorPro gateway enforces, so ReactorPro desktops and edges see RTerm as a first-class verified peer (gated invoke included). Identity is minted once and persisted (identityPath); the agent id is permanent (hashed into the fingerprint). Config in Settings (reactorpro block); secrets via the vault.
